facts.claim: Gaming apps retain a median 32% at day 1, 8% at day 7 and 3% at day 30, with strong performers at 40-50%, 12-18% and 5-8%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Gaming apps: strong performers 40-50% Day-1, 12-18% Day-7, 5-8% Day-30; medians 32%, 8% and 3%.

facts.claim: US App Store search install medians span 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, against 0.1% to 2.5% from browse
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: In August 2026, U.S. App Store Search medians spanned 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, while Browse produced 0.1% to 2.5%.

facts.claim: The average US App Store conversion rate across categories is 8.56%, with an average install rate of 3.8%
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: The average conversion rate across all categories on the US App Store was 8.56%, while the average install rate across all categories was 3.8%.

facts.claim: A three-day trial averages 26% cancellations against 51% for a thirty-day trial, and 31.1% of thirty-day trials cancel on day zero
facts.excerpt: A three day trial averages 26% cancellations; a 30 day one 51%. For 30-day trials, 31.1% cancel on day 0.

facts.claim: Median revenue per install at day 60 is 0.34 dollars across categories, with 0.66 and above indicating strong 60-day monetisation
facts.excerpt: Average revenue per install at Day 60 has a $0.34 median across all categories, with $0.66+ indicating strong 60-day monetization.

facts.claim: Strategy game sessions average 37.51 minutes and grew 18%, while casual game sessions rose 15% to 25.92 minutes
facts.source_title: Adjust's 2026 mobile app report: finance sessions up 21%, gaming CPI jumps 30%
facts.excerpt: Strategy game sessions averaged 37.51 minutes and grew 18%, while casual games rose 15% to 25.92 minutes.
